_note: Failure category prefix -> replay tests (names in tests/replay-taxonomy.test.ts) that must keep passing. tests/replay-taxonomy.test.ts fails if a prefix the categorizer can emit has no test here.
error: taxonomy: error -> llm error falls back, caller still answered
timeout: taxonomy: timeout -> tool progress-then-stall times out and hands off
tool_error: taxonomy: tool_error -> failed ticket tool never claims success
tool_misuse: taxonomy: tool_misuse -> invalid ticket args rejected by schema
fallback: taxonomy: fallback -> slow primary model uses small model inside budget
taxonomy: token_cap -> small model then human
handoff: taxonomy: handoff -> explicit ask and off-topic go to a human
low_confidence: taxonomy: handoff -> explicit ask and off-topic go to a human
failed_clarification: taxonomy: failed_clarification -> fillers re-ask, two failures hand off
unknown_intent_fallback_reply: taxonomy: failed_clarification -> fillers re-ask, two failures hand off
empty_answer: taxonomy: empty_answer -> every replay turn has a non-empty reply
over_latency_budget: taxonomy: over_latency_budget -> first audio inside budget under slow model and tool
filler_first: taxonomy: over_latency_budget -> first audio inside budget under slow model and tool
ungrounded_answer: taxonomy: ungrounded_answer -> invented price or time is blocked
pii_leak: taxonomy: pii_leak -> foreign phone number is blocked
guard_blocked: taxonomy: ungrounded_answer -> invented price or time is blocked
long_reply: taxonomy: long_reply -> model output capped, engine safety copy kept whole
token_cap: taxonomy: token_cap -> small model then human
wrong_route: taxonomy: wrong_route -> labelled replay turns route as expected
missed_handoff: taxonomy: handoff -> explicit ask and off-topic go to a human
expectation_failed: taxonomy: wrong_route -> labelled replay turns route as expected
